channel_error.scope: Analytic Frobenius projection of actual Hhat; ledger applies to projection. Outside-span error/cross retained explicitly.

data_residual.semantics: exact decomposition; residual mean square is not thermal variance

initial_estimator.pruning: final gamma threshold; posterior mean; no LS debias

confidence_error_groups.rule: absolute LLR bins with hard confidence .5/.75/.9/.99; lower-inclusive
confidence_error_groups.scope: offline calibration diagnostic; not selection thresholds

offline_truth_access: logger/evaluator only, never passed to observed receiver

posterior_audit.semantics: Gaussian BP aggregate; not finite-alphabet posterior moments

snapshot.scope: offline evidence with truth; observed receiver does not receive this path

timing_scope: instrumented diagnostic; not isolated A2 mean/p95 deployment cost gate
